metadata.case_name: CHUI FAI v. CHAN YUE HING AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: junior controller employed by Hong Kong Security Limited
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: obtain employment as a cashier or some other such sedentary post

injuries.description: His left leg was amputated through the knee.
source: His left leg was amputated through the knee.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of left lower leg at knee level

injuries.description: the right leg failed to survive and a below-knee amputation was carried out on 7th July, followed by skin grafting on 19th August.
source: the right leg failed to survive and a below-knee amputation was carried out on 7th July, followed by skin grafting on 19th August.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between right knee and ankle

manifestations.description: for the time being the plaintiff still has tenderness, particularly in the left stump.

he has experienced great difficulty and discomfort with the prostheses with which he has been fitted and which are of a modern pattern. He has lost confidence in them to such a degree that he has achieved little mobility and spends a great deal of time in his wheel chair.

The plaintiff has been unable to resume sexual relations with his wife. The reason is a matter of temperament, rather than physical. Dr. Ma said such a situation can be permanent. I take the view that this loss will probably be permanent.
The plaintiff can no longer play tennis which previously he played once a week.
He will be relieved of most of the present pain and discomfort.

treatments_received: left leg amputation through the knee
below-knee amputation of right leg on 7th July
treatments_future: replacement prostheses (conventional type) if plaintiff agrees
full time training at a government rehabilitation centre (if referred)

losses.description: Amputation of left leg through the knee.
Below-knee amputation of right leg (and subsequent skin grafting).
Achieved little mobility and spends a great deal of time in his wheel chair; will require prostheses and may walk with one or two canes if fitted.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Has been unable to resume sexual relations with his wife; the loss will probably be permanent.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
